title: carex caryophyllea f. refracta
intro: Carex caryophyllea f. refracta, commonly known as  Japanese sedges, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Carex genus. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Carex caryophyllea f. refracta include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, the bioactive constituents of Carex caryophyllea f. refracta are not extensively documented, and further research is needed to confirm their effects.
